tracks.srt_text:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:11,560
In the ancient, sun-drenched hills of Thrace, there lived a musician named Orpheus, whose music could tame the wildest beasts and bend the very trees to listen.

2
00:00:11,560 --> 00:00:19,080
Yet, of all the wonders of the earth, his heart belonged solely to the gentle nymph, Eurydice.

3
00:00:19,380 --> 00:00:28,180
They walked hand in hand through fields of wild lilies, their laughter harmonizing with the strings of his golden lyre.

4
00:00:28,680 --> 00:00:36,920
Orpheus whispered to her, 'As long as my lyre has song, my love, you shall never walk in shadow.'

5
00:00:37,920 --> 00:00:43,560
But fate is a cruel weaver, and shadow fell upon them all too soon.

6
00:00:43,560 --> 00:00:52,040
While running through the tall grass, Eurydice trod upon a venomous viper, its fangs sinking deep into her ankle.

7
00:00:52,340 --> 00:01:01,620
Before the sun could set, her spirit departed, leaving Orpheus to weep over her cold, lifeless form.

8
00:01:02,120 --> 00:01:08,760
He cried out to the heavens, 'Take my life also, or return my beloved to the light!'

9
00:01:09,760 --> 00:01:18,320
Unable to bear the silence of her absence, Orpheus resolved to do what no living mortal had ever dared.

10
00:01:18,320 --> 00:01:26,080
He descended into the deep, yawning cavern of Taenarum, seeking the gates of the Underworld.

11
00:01:26,380 --> 00:01:36,460
At the banks of the misty River Styx, his sorrowful music softened the cold heart of Charon, who ferried him across the dark waters.

12
00:01:37,460 --> 00:01:46,740
Deep within the silent realm of the dead, Orpheus stood before the obsidian throne of Hades, Lord of the Underworld.

13
00:01:46,740 --> 00:01:57,580
He struck his lyre, pouring all his grief, his memories of the sunlit meadows, and his desperate love into a single, haunting melody.

14
00:01:57,880 --> 00:02:06,120
The cold stones of the Underworld wept, and even the relentless Furies stayed their torment to listen.

15
00:02:07,120 --> 00:02:12,480
For the first time, the stern heart of Hades was moved to pity.

16
00:02:12,880 --> 00:02:22,360
Hades spoke, his voice echoing like rolling thunder, 'You may lead her back to the realm of the living, musician.'

17
00:02:22,960 --> 00:02:33,480
'But heed this warning: she will follow behind you, and you must not turn to look at her until you have both crossed into the light of the sun.'

18
00:02:34,080 --> 00:02:39,360
'If you look back but once, she will remain mine forever.'

19
00:02:40,360 --> 00:02:47,920
With hope rekindled, Orpheus began the arduous journey back up through the silent, dark caverns.

20
00:02:47,920 --> 00:02:53,240
The silence was oppressive, weighing heavily on his racing heart.

21
00:02:53,540 --> 00:03:01,100
He could hear no footsteps behind him, only his own breath and the faint rustle of the wind ahead.

22
00:03:01,600 --> 00:03:10,120
A terrible doubt began to gnaw at his mind: was she truly there, or had the Lord of the Dead deceived him?

23
00:03:11,120 --> 00:03:17,080
At last, Orpheus stepped out into the warm, golden light of the upper world.

24
00:03:17,080 --> 00:03:24,560
In his overwhelming joy and relief, he forgot the warning, and turned to look back at his beautiful bride.

25
00:03:24,960 --> 00:03:29,560
But Eurydice was still within the shadow of the cavern.

26
00:03:29,860 --> 00:03:37,340
As their eyes met, she began to fade, slipping back into the dark depths like a wisp of smoke.

27
00:03:37,840 --> 00:03:44,360
She whispered her final, agonizing farewell: 'Goodbye, my love.'

28
00:03:45,560 --> 00:03:50,360
Orpheus reached out, but grasped only empty air.

29
00:03:50,360 --> 00:03:56,080
He tried to return, but the gates of the Underworld were shut against him forever.

30
00:03:56,380 --> 00:04:07,580
For the rest of his days, he wandered the wild hills alone, playing songs of such profound sorrow that the world itself seemed to weep with him.

31
00:04:08,080 --> 00:04:16,440
Waiting for the day when his own song would end, and he would finally join his beloved Eurydice in the quiet shadows.
